Final rebar-debug report (local repair commit 21495720e73ab074f75ddbdbab36baa6de12f793; not yet pushed).

Problem: shipped top-level help and maintained ticket-model prose still claimed unlink had no relation selector after optional relation-scoped unlink shipped.

Proven root cause: commit 73abb5805f deliberately added relation selection to the library/CLI and updated subcommand help, user guide, and generated CLI reference, but omitted the independently maintained src/rebar/_cli/help/overview.txt and docs/ticket-model.md. A construct sweep found the same pre-change operation wording in docs/event-schema.md. Live reproduction showed `rebar unlink --help` correct while `rebar --help` remained pair-only; history ruled out generation drift or a competing runtime cause.

Proof: the real packaged top-level subprocess printed `no relation arg`, while existing e39f interface tests proved explicit relation removal and omission fallback. The introducing diff did not touch any stale surface. Defect legitimacy is grounded in the operator-ratified e39f commit and current public CLI/library behavior.

Test: tests/interfaces/contracts/test_unlink_documentation_contract_b6e1.py was collected and executed in final form. With no repair present, all 3 tests were RED for the intended missing-[relation] assertions. The test was removed entirely before the held-out fixer worked. After restoring it, a wording-parser overconstraint was exposed; per the test-modification guard the repair was fully removed, the parser was revised, final-form RED was reproved 3/3, then the unchanged repair was reapplied and GREEN 3/3. Exact-defect mutation restoring all three stale statements returned all 3 tests to RED; restoring the repair returned GREEN. The oracle observes a real CLI subprocess and semantic published-doc consequences, so behavior-preserving internal refactors do not affect it.

Fix: overview now advertises `unlink <source> <target> [relation]` and both modes; ticket-model documents exact relation removal plus historical fallback; event-schema separates operation selection from the emitted UNLINK cancellation by link_uuid. Doctor-specific prose remains truthful about its current fallback-based ambiguous-pair refusal; no runtime behavior changed.

Scope & safety: docs/help plus one interface contract test only; no caller behavioral dependency, runtime/API edit, new dependency, generated reference change, or test weakening. Existing correct subcommand help was used as trusted prior art.

Siblings: construct sweep found and fixed docs/event-schema.md in scope. No other contradictory maintained public docs/help statements remain under src/rebar/_cli/help or docs (experiments excluded). Parity sweep is N/A because the repaired artifact is published documentation, not an operation implementation; live library/CLI behavior was already covered, while MCP parity is separately owned by airy-starchy-muntjac.

Residual risk & prevention: doctor still intentionally uses the pair-scoped fallback to classify ambiguous repair pairs (src/rebar/_commands/doctor.py and tests/scripts/graph/test_doctor.py); accepted here because changing that tested runtime contract is outside this documentation-only ticket and the corrected prose names the limitation without claiming the public API lacks relation selection. No other observed fragility remains.

Replication: real `rebar --help` now prints the optional selector, most-recent omission fallback, and exact explicit mode. Focused matrix: 32 passed. `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check`, `python scripts/check_docs_index.py`, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` passed with the worktree venv. Commit trailer verification passed; DCO and Change-Id are present.
